toy_15_state_convergence.description: Analytic 15-state CTMC experiment from Section 6.1 / Appendix D.1: high-order samplers should converge faster in KL than first-order tau-leaping, including under a matched function-evaluation budget.

convergence_order.description: Estimated decay order of KL error across the scored convergence grid.

kl_at_max_steps.description: KL divergence from the analytic target distribution at the largest scored step budget.

mean_kl.description: Mean KL over the scored step budgets, rewarding methods that improve across the convergence grid rather than only at the largest budget.

kl_at_common_nfe.description: KL divergence at the largest number of function evaluations shared by every scored method; this is the headline matched-compute quality metric.

total_variation_at_common_nfe.description: Total variation distance at the largest shared NFE budget, a bounded matched-compute quality check.

mean_total_variation.description: Mean total variation distance across the scored step budgets, catching methods that optimize KL at only one budget.

total_variation_at_max_steps.description: Total variation distance to the analytic target at the largest scored step budget, a bounded distribution-quality check complementary to KL.

worst_state_abs_error_at_max_steps.description: Largest absolute state-probability error at the largest scored step budget, catching methods that hide poor tail-state behavior in aggregate KL.

slice_state_subset_kl_at_max_steps.description: KL divergence on the slice-specific stratified state subset after renormalization, making state-wise overfitting visible.

slice_state_subset_mass_abs_error_at_max.description: Absolute error in the total probability mass assigned to the slice-specific state subset at the largest scored step budget.

max_steps.description: Largest scored discretization step count, a machine-independent compute-size constraint.

max_nfe.description: Largest scored number of function evaluations, penalizing extra solver work independent of wall-clock hardware.

common_nfe.description: Largest NFE budget shared by all scored methods for matched-compute comparison.

mean_rejection_rate.description: Mean rejected proposal fraction over scored runs, penalizing unstable or invalid jump proposals.

positive_intensity_fraction.description: Mean fraction of proposed intensities reported positive; methods that do not report this validity diagnostic score 0.0.
